classes.name: accumulating share class
classes.label: accumulating share class
classes.definition: A share class in which there is no option to reinvest.

classes.name: asset class strategy
classes.label: asset class strategy
classes.definition: Strategy which is asset class based.

classes.name: common share in fund
classes.label: common share in fund
classes.definition: A share unit in a fund, which is classified as a Common Share class.

classes.name: currency strategy
classes.label: currency strategy
classes.definition: Strategy which is currency based.

classes.name: equity fund
classes.label: equity fund
classes.definition: A fund which invests in at least 85% shares.

classes.name: equity portfolio
classes.label: equity portfolio
classes.definition: A portfolio which has at least 85% exposure to shares.

classes.name: fonds commun de placement
classes.label: fonds commun de placement
classes.definition: open-ended collective investment fund, which is a contractual form set up between the fund manager and investors and not a separate legal entity

classes.name: fund accountant
classes.label: fund accountant
classes.definition: The party that keeps accounting records of the available assets and liabilities of the Fund. It calculates dealing prices, the Net Asset Value (NAV) of the Fund, and may provide fund performance and tax data. Can be subcontracted by the FundAdministrator.

classes.name: fund bond class unit
classes.label: fund bond class unit
classes.definition: A fund unit which takes the form of debt in that fund.

classes.name: fund bond unit coupon
classes.label: fund bond unit coupon
classes.definition: A fixed coupon paid out to holders of the Fund Bond Unit.

classes.name: fund cash distribution policy
classes.label: fund cash distribution policy
classes.definition: Policy for distribution of cash dividends or notes in the event that the fund units have a distribution policy of "Cash" rather than "Reinvestment".

classes.name: fund classification
classes.label: fund classification
classes.definition: The category of the fund according to the asset class. This is a published code by which the Fund is classified. Further notes: Could be EFCF codes. This is the way in which "Type of fund" is articulated.

classes.name: fund classification scheme
classes.label: fund classification scheme
classes.definition: A published scheme for the category of a fund according to the asset class.

classes.name: fund coupon policy
classes.label: fund coupon policy
classes.definition: Terms for the expected distribution of bond unit coupons.

classes.name: fund depositary
classes.label: fund depositary
classes.definition: The party that holds and safeguards holdings owned by a fund. It is also responsible for compliance of the portfolio with legal ratios etc.

classes.name: fund distribution policy
classes.label: fund distribution policy
classes.definition: policy indicating the overall strategy or limitations on distribution for the fund

classes.name: fund distributor
classes.label: fund distributor
classes.definition: an entity through which a fund may be bought by or for an investor. This may be on a discretionary or advisory basis, or as an execution-only service. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

classes.name: fund dividend policy
classes.label: fund dividend policy
classes.definition: Terms for the expected distributions of dividends.

classes.name: fund investment objective
classes.label: fund investment objective
classes.definition: The aim of a Fund e.g outperfom a given benchmark.

classes.name: fund investment policy
classes.label: fund investment policy
classes.definition: policy that the fund implements in order to achieve the stated fund objectives

classes.name: fund legal form documentation
classes.label: fund legal form documentation
classes.definition: For a fund which is constituted under the law of contract, the constitution or articles that define the fund. These are embodied in a Contract.

classes.name: fund order desk
classes.label: fund order desk
classes.definition: The Fund Order Desk is a party to the Fund Order Desk Account.

classes.name: fund portfolio
classes.label: fund portfolio
classes.definition: An account containing a number of financial instruments along with cash positions in one or more currencies and belonging to a Fund

classes.name: fund portfolio investment limitations
classes.label: fund portfolio investment limitations
classes.definition: Detailed Policy on approximately how the portfolio is to be allocated to achieve the stated investment goals. This underpins the detailed strategy of how to achieve this.

classes.name: fund portfolio investment policy
classes.label: fund portfolio investment policy
classes.definition: policy with respect to allocation of the portfolio that is designed to meet the stated investment strategy and goals

classes.name: fund processing general terms
classes.label: fund processing general terms
classes.definition: Formal terms for general processing of the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do.

classes.name: fund processing terms
classes.label: fund processing terms
classes.definition: Formal terms for processing of the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do. These include terms for redemption and subscription processing as well as general processing terms. ISO FIBIM definition: Processing characteristics linked to the instrument, ie, not to the market.

rules.property: defines main fund order desk account

classes.name: fund redemption terms
classes.label: fund redemption terms
classes.definition: Formal terms for redemption of units in the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do.

classes.name: fund reinvestment policy
classes.label: fund reinvestment policy
classes.definition: Terms for the expected reinvestment of profits on fund units.

classes.name: fund share class unit
classes.label: fund share class unit
classes.definition: The legal structure in which you can purchase part of an investment pool, defined by a variety of characteristics like investor type, minimum size of investment, distribution type, fee and currency. A fund unit which gives the holder an equity stake in the fund.

classes.name: fund subscription terms
classes.label: fund subscription terms
classes.definition: Subscription terms for the fund. Further notes: ISO FIBIM, EFAMA DD and FPP combine terms for subscription, redemption and general holding requirements. These have been separated here as they are different kinds of term, but this can be reviewed. Subscription Terms are identified as terms of the fund and not the fund unit, since terms for how you might subscribe can't be binding one someone who has not yet subscribed.

classes.name: fund supervisory authority
classes.label: fund supervisory authority
classes.definition: party that supervises the fund or fund industry

classes.name: fund transfer agent
classes.label: fund transfer agent
classes.definition: An entity that undertakes the execution of subscription, redemption and switch orders on behalf of a fund. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

classes.name: fund unit distribution method
classes.label: fund unit distribution method
classes.definition: The normal distribution policy for funds.

classes.name: fund unit distribution policy
classes.label: fund unit distribution policy
classes.definition: policy relating to the unit, e.g. if income is paid out or retained in the fund and how this is treated, including distribution policy details for dividends and coupons.

classes.name: funds cash distribution
classes.label: funds cash distribution
classes.definition: Accrued income is distributed periodically to the investor.

classes.name: funds processing
classes.label: funds processing
classes.definition: The context of managing and processing funds, issuing funds units etc. This is the context in which the different parties involved in a fund are defined as parties.

classes.name: funds processing account
classes.label: funds processing account
classes.definition: An account used specifically in the processing of funds. Like all accounts this is (per FIBIM definition) a business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer. Please refer to Financial global model for treatment of accounts relationships in this model.

classes.name: funds processing party
classes.label: funds processing party
classes.definition: party involved in the processing of funds

classes.name: income accumulation
classes.label: income accumulation
classes.definition: Accrued income is not distributed and instead remains reflected within the unit/share price.

classes.name: fund investment restrictions set
classes.label: fund investment restrictions set
classes.definition: Limitations that apply to the fund as a whole, such as risk factors. these are used to determine whether the fund is appropriate for a given type of investor to invest in.

classes.name: investment strategy
classes.label: investment strategy
classes.definition: plan, method, or series of maneuvers or stratagems for obtaining a specific investment goal

classes.name: jurisdiction strategy
classes.label: jurisdiction strategy
classes.definition: Strategy which is jurisdiction based.

classes.name: key investor information document
classes.label: key investor information document
classes.definition: short document that provides critical information for investors, summarizing content derived from a prospectus such that it can be understood by investors without reference to other documents, as required by law in the European Union

classes.name: net asset value calculation method
classes.label: net asset value calculation method
classes.definition: Parameters for the calculation of the net asset value for an investment fund/fund class.

classes.name: note fund
classes.label: note fund
classes.definition: pooled investment vehicle that issues debt instruments (notes) to investors rather than (or in addition to) traditional equity interests

classes.name: note fund share
classes.label: note fund share
classes.definition: investment interest in a fund that issues notes rather than traditional equity, in cases where the fund is structured as a company

classes.name: note fund unit
classes.label: note fund unit
classes.definition: investment interest in a fund that issues notes rather than traditional equity, in cases where the fund is structured as a trust, partnership, or unitized fund

classes.name: organization strategy
classes.label: organization strategy
classes.definition: Strategy which is organization based.

classes.name: other investment fund information
classes.label: other investment fund information
classes.definition: Things which are not part of the prospectus but are important if you want to understand the fund.

classes.name: portfolio benchmark
classes.label: portfolio benchmark
classes.definition: Security or other price against which the performance of the portfolio is evaluated.

classes.name: portfolio investment strategy
classes.label: portfolio investment strategy
classes.definition: The manner in which the portfolio manager tries to reach the funds objectives.

classes.name: private equity holding
classes.label: private equity holding
classes.definition: A holding of private equity.

classes.name: real estate holding
classes.label: real estate holding
classes.definition: tangible asset consisting of real estate that is owned or controlled by an individual, organization, or entity for investment, operational, or strategic purposes

classes.name: refer to fund order desk
classes.label: refer to fund order desk
classes.definition: Restriction requiring an investor to refer to the fund order desk prior to redeeming a fund.

classes.name: s i c a f
classes.label: s i c a f
classes.definition: A French fund vehicle type. Designation and definition needed.

classes.name: s i c a v
classes.label: s i c a v
classes.definition: Societe Collective a Capital Variable

classes.name: sector strategy
classes.label: sector strategy
classes.definition: Strategy which is sector based.

classes.name: unit issuer
classes.label: unit issuer
classes.definition: The party which issues the Fund Unit.

classes.name: aligned community investment fund
classes.label: aligned community investment fund
classes.definition: community investment fund that raises capital publicly from community members and deploys some of that capital via investments into its client businesses or other businesses in the community

classes.name: closed-end investment
classes.label: closed-end investment
classes.definition: investment fund that has a fixed number of shares offered by an investment company through an initial public offering

classes.name: community investment fund
classes.label: community investment fund
classes.definition: professionally-managed investment fund with three essential characteristics: capital is sourced from people in the community (ideally from retail/non-accredited investors); capital is invested into local people, projects, and businesses; and capital is deployed by individuals in the community, typically but not necessarily a nonprofit fund

classes.name: diversified community investment fund
classes.label: diversified community investment fund
classes.definition: community investment fund that invests primarily in real estate but can also invest in any local business or project, and can do so with investment capital raised publicly from within the fund's own community, including community investors

classes.name: exchange-traded fund
classes.label: exchange-traded fund
classes.definition: investment fund whose fund units are traded on an exchange, much like stocks

classes.name: fund administrator
classes.label: fund administrator
classes.definition: role of the party responsible for managing the operational, accounting, and compliance functions of an investment fund

classes.name: fund contract
classes.label: fund contract
classes.definition: contract that embodies and defines the fund legal form in cases where there is no independent organization

classes.name: fund holder
classes.label: fund holder
classes.definition: party that owns units in or a percentage of and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some fund, provided in exchange for investment

classes.name: fund holding
classes.label: fund holding
classes.definition: ownership interest in a fund, which may represented by fund units that confer financial rights and governance privileges

classes.name: fund manager
classes.label: fund manager
classes.definition: role of the party responsible for making investment decisions and managing the portfolio of an investment fund

classes.name: fund of funds
classes.label: fund of funds
classes.definition: investment fund that invests directly in other investment funds rather than investing in stocks, bonds, and other securities

classes.name: fund position
classes.label: fund position
classes.definition: position in some fund, which may be defined in terms of fund units

classes.name: fund unit
classes.label: fund unit
classes.definition: quantified share of beneficial interest in a pooled fund, representing a proportional claim on the fund's assets, income, or entitlements

classes.name: hedge fund
classes.label: hedge fund
classes.definition: investment fund that pursues a total return and is usually open to qualified investors only

classes.name: legal fund structure
classes.label: legal fund structure
classes.definition: structure of a fund with respect to its legal formation in some jurisdiction

classes.name: mutual fund
classes.label: mutual fund
classes.definition: open-end professionally managed investment fund established for the purpose of investing in securities such as stocks, bonds, money market instruments and similar assets

classes.name: non-tradable fund unit
classes.label: non-tradable fund unit
classes.definition: security representing an interest in a fund that cannot be traded ontside of the fund itself

classes.name: nonprofit fund
classes.label: nonprofit fund
classes.definition: investment vehicle designed to support a nonprofit mission, whose objectives include environmental stewardship and/or social responsibility in addition to financial performance

classes.name: open-end investment
classes.label: open-end investment
classes.definition: investment fund that offered through a fund company that sells shares directly to investors

classes.name: pension fund
classes.label: pension fund
classes.definition: investment fund run by a financial intermediary on behalf of an organization and its employees/members

classes.name: private credit fund
classes.label: private credit fund
classes.definition: investment vehicle that provides loans or other forms of credit to companies, typically outside of the traditional banking system

classes.name: private equity fund
classes.label: private equity fund
classes.definition: investment fund used for making investments in various equity (and to a lesser extent debt) securities according to an investment strategy associated with private equity

classes.name: real estate investment trust
classes.label: real estate investment trust
classes.definition: investment fund that offers shares/units to the public and invests in real estate directly

classes.name: sovereign wealth fund
classes.label: sovereign wealth fund
classes.definition: state-owned investment fund that consists of pools of money derived from a country's reserves

classes.name: tradable fund unit
classes.label: tradable fund unit
classes.definition: security representing a tradable interest in a fund

classes.name: unit trust
classes.label: unit trust
classes.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent beneficial ownership in a trust-managed portfolio of assets

classes.name: unitized fund
classes.label: unitized fund
classes.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent a proportional share of the fund's underlying assets, typically used in pensions or insurance-based products

edges.name: accounting year end date
edges.label: accounting year end date
edges.definition: Last day of the accounting year for the fund.

edges.name: authorized country
edges.label: authorized country
edges.definition: Country in which it is authorised to commercialise the fund.

edges.name: benchmark weight
edges.label: benchmark weight
edges.definition: Instrument weighting in the benchmark for the portfolio.

edges.name: coupon payment date
edges.label: coupon payment date
edges.definition: The date at which the coupon is distributed to the bond unit holder.

edges.name: defines main fund order desk account
edges.label: defines main fund order desk account

edges.name: end of fiscal year
edges.label: end of fiscal year
edges.definition: Day and month on any given year at which the books are closed and profit and loss is determined.

edges.name: ex coupon date
edges.label: ex coupon date
edges.definition: The date at which the coupon is substracted from the NAV

edges.name: has data provider
edges.label: has data provider
edges.definition: has an organization which is the data provider and is legally responsible for the information provided

edges.name: has details
edges.label: has details
edges.definition: Information on the net asset value calculation of the investment fund component.

edges.name: has fund policy
edges.label: has fund policy
edges.definition: Overall policy for amounts invested, limitations etc. Not the same as the detailed Portfolio policy.

edges.name: has issue date
edges.label: has issue date
edges.definition: Date of first NAV calculation and start of performance calculations (same as launch date)

edges.name: inception date
edges.label: inception date
edges.definition: Authorization date in the country of origin.

edges.name: inception date
edges.label: inception date
edges.definition: Authorization date in the country of origin. Further Notes See definition in Inception Date for Fund. Separate fact exists here. Same definition used. EFAMA Review notes: Inception Date exists as soon as there is a prospectus, so it is a fact about a Share Class even if the share class is never formally issued or offered to the public. Legal structure exists even if something is not launched. Editor question: Review stated this was a fact about Share Class; confirm this fact does not apply to Bond and Note units, or was the term Share Class being used to mean all three? Meanwhile I have put the term "Issue Date" as a fact about all Fund Unit, as this is given a sa separate term in the EFAMA DD spreadsheet. MAy come clearer in the next version of that.

edges.name: initial application form
edges.label: initial application form
edges.definition: Physical application form for the initial subscription by the investor.

edges.name: issue price
edges.label: issue price
edges.definition: The price at which the Fund Unit was first issued.

edges.name: maximum deviation
edges.label: maximum deviation
edges.definition: Maximum allowable deviation from the benchmark.

edges.name: maximum investment amount
edges.label: maximum investment amount
edges.definition: Maximum amount that may be invested in the specified strategy.

edges.name: maximum investment percentage
edges.label: maximum investment percentage
edges.definition: Maximum percentage that may be invested in the specified strategy.

edges.name: maximum purchasing fee
edges.label: maximum purchasing fee
edges.definition: Maximum percentage or fixed amount of money due when purchasing fund shares Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: maximum redemption amount
edges.label: maximum redemption amount
edges.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount that can be sold.

edges.name: maximum redemption fee
edges.label: maximum redemption fee
edges.definition: Maximum percentage or fixed amount of money due when redeeming fund shares Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: maximum redemption percentage
edges.label: maximum redemption percentage
edges.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as a percentage that can be sold.

edges.name: may also be
edges.label: may also be
edges.definition: The unit issuer would be the fund administrator (except when it is a Bond).

edges.name: minimum deviation
edges.label: minimum deviation
edges.definition: Minimum allowable deviation from the benchmark.

edges.name: minimum holding period
edges.label: minimum holding period
edges.definition: Period, in days, during which the units/shares must be held following their issue before redemption will be permitted.

edges.name: minimum initial subscription amount
edges.label: minimum initial subscription amount
edges.definition: Minimum initial subscription value.

edges.name: minimum investment amount
edges.label: minimum investment amount
edges.definition: Minimum amount that has to be invested in the specified strategy.

edges.name: minimum investment percentage
edges.label: minimum investment percentage
edges.definition: Minimum percentage that has to be invested in the specified strategy.

edges.name: minimum rating restriction
edges.label: minimum rating restriction
edges.definition: The minimum rating of securities to be invested in.

edges.name: minimum remaining holding amount
edges.label: minimum remaining holding amount
edges.definition: Minimum value of units/shares that must be retained to avoid automatic redemption.

edges.name: minimum subscription amount
edges.label: minimum subscription amount
edges.definition: Minimum subscription value for existing investors.

edges.name: percentage invested
edges.label: percentage invested
edges.definition: The percentage of funds that is to be invested at any given time.

edges.name: performance fee
edges.label: performance fee
edges.definition: Fees paid for the achivements of predefined outperformance objectives Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: processing country
edges.label: processing country
edges.definition: Country in which the processing characteristic applies.

edges.name: purchasing fee
edges.label: purchasing fee
edges.definition: Actual percentage or fixed amount of money due when purchasing fund shares Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: redemption cutoff date time
edges.label: redemption cutoff date time
edges.definition: Last date/time at which an order to redeem can be given.

edges.name: redemption dealing frequency
edges.label: redemption dealing frequency
edges.definition: Frequency at which the redemptions are done.

edges.name: redemption fee
edges.label: redemption fee
edges.definition: Actual percentage or fixed amount of money due when redeeming fund shares Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: redemption form
edges.label: redemption form
edges.definition: Physical written instruction/renunciation form for redemption of units/shares by the investor.

edges.name: redemption period
edges.label: redemption period
edges.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be redeemed.

edges.name: reinvestment frequency
edges.label: reinvestment frequency
edges.definition: For units where there is Reinvestment distribution, the frequency with which the reinvestment takes place (this will be the same or less frequently than the Dividend Payment Frequency), otherwise this fact does not apply.

edges.name: stated management fee
edges.label: stated management fee
edges.definition: The fee that is stated in the Prospectus as being what is to be charged for management. Further notes: Can be monetary amount or a percentage or a combination. Action: simple type is wrong.

edges.name: subscription cutoff date time
edges.label: subscription cutoff date time
edges.definition: Last date/time at which an order to subscribe can be given.

edges.name: subscription dealing frequency
edges.label: subscription dealing frequency
edges.definition: Frequency at which the subscriptions are done.

edges.name: subscription period
edges.label: subscription period
edges.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be subscribed to.

edges.name: subsequent application form
edges.label: subsequent application form
edges.definition: Physical application form for subsequent investments by the same investor.

edges.name: switching fee
edges.label: switching fee
edges.definition: Actual percentage or fixed amount of money due when switching to another fund. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

edges.name: tracking error
edges.label: tracking error
edges.definition: See RiskFactors narrative in EFAMA DD

edges.name: valuation frequency
edges.label: valuation frequency
edges.definition: Frequency of the net asset value calculation.

edges.name: value at risk
edges.label: value at risk
edges.definition: See RiskClassification_NameOf in EFAMA DD Applies to Fund not Portfolio.

edges.name: has legal structure
edges.label: has legal structure
edges.definition: indicates the legal form that the fund takes

edges.name: has sub-fund
edges.label: has sub-fund
edges.definition: relates a pooled fund to a sub-fund that is a constituent of the parent fund

edges.name: is sub-fund of
edges.label: is sub-fund of
edges.definition: relates a pooled fund to a parent fund

attributes.name: additional restrictions
attributes.label: additional restrictions
attributes.definition: Other restrictions or treatment information in respect of this strategy and the organization to which it refers.

attributes.name: back end load applicable
attributes.label: back end load applicable
attributes.definition: Whether an exit charge, eg, CDSC, on redemption orders for this class can be applied.

attributes.name: blacklisted
attributes.label: blacklisted
attributes.definition: Whether or not the strategy in framed so as to include the referenced business entity as being blacklisted. If yes, the strategy prevents investment in securities issued by that organization.

attributes.name: clear funds required
attributes.label: clear funds required
attributes.definition: Whether cleared funds may be required before a subscription order can be executed.

attributes.name: dealing frequency description
attributes.label: dealing frequency description
attributes.definition: Description of frequency at which the subscriptions and redemptions are done.

attributes.name: declaration channel
attributes.label: declaration channel
attributes.definition: Means of the net asset value publication, eg, a newspaper.

attributes.name: distribution with reinvestment
attributes.label: distribution with reinvestment
attributes.definition: It is possible to hold shares for which the accrued income is distributed, but then reinvested automatically in additional units/shares allocated to the investor.

attributes.name: dual fund
attributes.label: dual fund
attributes.definition: Whether the fund has two prices.

attributes.name: first accounting year end date
attributes.label: first accounting year end date
attributes.definition: Last day of the first accounting year for the fund.

attributes.name: first n a v calculation date
attributes.label: first n a v calculation date
attributes.definition: The first date of NAV calculation

attributes.name: front end load applicable
attributes.label: front end load applicable
attributes.definition: Whether a front end charge on subscription orders for this class can be applied.

attributes.name: fund class type identifier
attributes.label: fund class type identifier
attributes.definition: A textual identification of the class of fund units. This is used to uniquely identify a particular class of fund units, and thereby identify features of this type of unit within the fund.

attributes.name: historic pricing indicator
attributes.label: historic pricing indicator
attributes.definition: Indicates whether the price is historic or forward.

attributes.name: holder may reinvest
attributes.label: holder may reinvest
attributes.definition: Whether or not the holder may reinvest dividends in the fund.

attributes.name: holding transferable
attributes.label: holding transferable
attributes.definition: Whether registered investors are able to transfer some or all of their holdings to third parties.

attributes.name: include related firms
attributes.label: include related firms
attributes.definition: Whether or not the strategy includes firms which are related in some way to the referenced organization.

attributes.name: inclusion
attributes.label: inclusion
attributes.definition: Whether the referred strategy is included. No means this description refers to the exclusion of what is described, from the portfolio.

attributes.name: investment focus
attributes.label: investment focus
attributes.definition: The information about the area the fund is mostly invested into (for example stock market in Germany).

attributes.name: launch date
attributes.label: launch date
attributes.definition: Date of first NAV calculation and start of performance calculations

attributes.name: limited shares are issued
attributes.label: limited shares are issued
attributes.definition: Whether or not new shares can be issued in the fund. This is what makes it a closed end or open end fund.

attributes.name: main fund order desk
attributes.label: main fund order desk
attributes.definition: Whether the fund order desk is the principal entity appointed by the fund to which orders should be submitted.

attributes.name: maximum redemption units
attributes.label: maximum redemption units
attributes.definition: Maximum number of shares/units that may be redeemed on a single dealing day.

attributes.name: minimum initial subscription units
attributes.label: minimum initial subscription units
attributes.definition: Minimum initial number of units/shares that must be purchased.

attributes.name: minimum remaining holding units
attributes.label: minimum remaining holding units
attributes.definition: Minimum number of units/shares that must be retained to avoid automatic redemption.

attributes.name: minimum subscription units
attributes.label: minimum subscription units
attributes.definition: Minimum number of units/shares that must be purchased by existing investors.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: name
attributes.definition: Name of the investment fund.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: name
attributes.definition: Name given to the defined strategy.

attributes.name: physical document required
attributes.label: physical document required
attributes.definition: Whether a phsyical form is required through the main fund order desk. Yes: A phsyical form is required through the main fund order desk. No: A phsyical form is not required through the main fund order desk.

attributes.name: product group description
attributes.label: product group description
attributes.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

attributes.name: redemption cycle in business days
attributes.label: redemption cycle in business days
attributes.definition: The last business day following the day on which a redemption order is priced (T) by which settlement will be due for orders placed with the main Fund Order Desk. Alternatively, if proceeds will be paid following receipt of written renunciation, the last business day following receipt of the relevant renunciation documentation by the main Fund Order Desk (R) by which the proceeds will be sent.

attributes.name: redemption in amount allowed
attributes.label: redemption in amount allowed
attributes.definition: Whether redemptions in amount are allowed.

attributes.name: registration date
attributes.label: registration date
attributes.definition: The date at which the fund is legally approved in a country other than the country of origin.

attributes.name: signature required
attributes.label: signature required
attributes.definition: Whether a phsyical form with the investor's written signature is required through the main fund order desk. Yes:A phsyical form with the investor's written signature is required through the main fund order desk.

attributes.name: stated investment aim
attributes.label: stated investment aim
attributes.definition: The stated aim of the Fund in words, e.g outperfom a given benchmark.

attributes.name: stated objective
attributes.label: stated objective
attributes.definition: The stated objective of the fund, in words.

attributes.name: subscriptions in amount allowed
attributes.label: subscriptions in amount allowed
attributes.definition: Whether subscriptions in amount are allowed.

attributes.name: switching chargeable
attributes.label: switching chargeable
attributes.definition: Whether a switching charge for changing between sub-funds of the same umbrella can be applied.

attributes.name: type of securities
attributes.label: type of securities
attributes.definition: The type of securities or other holdings that may be invested in.

attributes.name: valuation frequency textual description
attributes.label: valuation frequency textual description
attributes.definition: Description of the frequency of the net asset value calculation.

attributes.name: is open ended
attributes.label: is open ended
attributes.definition: indicates whether the fund is an open-end/closed-end fund

attributes.name: is private
attributes.label: is private
attributes.definition: indicates that the fund does not offer its securities to the general public
